title: Aagaya Maahe Moharram
body:
Aagaya maahe moharram
Chand moharram ka nazar aagaya
Chha gaie gham ki faza'a
Ya Hussain(a.s.) Hussain(a.s.) ya Hussain(a.s.)
Hussain(a.s.) ya Hussain(a.s.) ya Hussain(a.s.) ya Hussain(a.s.)
<<MINI>>
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a
Arsh say aa'nsoo bahanay aagai hain Fatima(s.a.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaib-e-tan aih-e-aza'a nay karliyay kaalay libas
Haath hain seeno'n pe, aa'soo aankh mein, chehray udaas
Hai juloos-e-gham kahi'n par (x2) aur kahi'n majlis bapa
<<MINI>>
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a
Arsh say aa'nsoo bahanay aagai hain Fatima(s.a.)
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a

Nasb karti hain azakhanay kaneezaan-e-batool(s.a.)
Hath mein patka alam ka, lab pe noha, dil malool
Alqamah aa'nkho'n say jaari (x2)
Lab pe haaey Karbala
<<MINI>>

Daikh kar maah-e-aza'a ko, maa'n nay bachcho'n say kaha
Aao main tum ko sikhaao'n kia hai tehzeeb-e-aza'a
Ba wuzoo hokar hi parhhna (x2)
Soz, noha, marsiyah
<<MINI>>
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a

Yeh azadari chali hai syed-e-sajjad(a.s.) say
Zakri ki ibtida hai Zainab(s.a.)-e-naashaad say
Perawi sajjad(a.s.) ki hai (x2)
Bairhiyaa'n, shaal-e-aza'a
<<MINI>>
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a

Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a

Ban kay saqqa-e-Sakina(s.a.), tifl aur peer-o-jawaa'n
Syedo'n kay ghar pe jaakay pursa daitay hain wahaa'n
Yeh wohi din hain ke jis mein (x2)
Aap ka ghar lut gaya
<<MINI>>
Aagaya maah-e-moharram, bich gaya farsh-e-aza'a

Yaad mein eik bay watan(a.s.) kay halqa-e-zanjeer hai
Apnay hi khoo'n mein nahaa kay (x2)
Kehtay hain khooni qaba
<<MINI>>

Soz khuwaa'n fizza(s.a.)-o-laila(s.a.) aur Zainab(s.a.) zakira
Fatima(s.a.) sughra ka noha (x2)
Matmi aal-e-aba'a(a.s.)
<<MINI>>

Kehtay thay aihl-e-Madina say yehi rotay huway
Chaand dekho jab aza'a ka (x2)
Tum yehi karna buka

Eik teray gham nay hi mola(a.s.) (x2)
Sab ko yak jaa kardiya
